articles.title: Luke Dashjr exits mining pool Ocean after split over Bitcoin mining’s future
articles.snippet: The split was mutual, with both parties citing differing views on the future of Bitcoin mining and recent protocol developments.

articles.title: Bitcoin barely blinks as U.S. hits Iran, sending oil higher and stocks lower
articles.snippet: BTC remains August's best-performing asset after the latest escalation in geopolitical tensions.

articles.title: Crypto market makers are cashing in on bitcoin's rally - without betting on direction
articles.snippet: As bitcoin surges back above $80,000, sophisticated trading firms are quietly collecting yield rather than making directional bet.

articles.title: A $1.1 million crypto card hack crashed a neobank's token 49%
articles.snippet: The exploit caused the neobank's AVICI token to drop 49% from a 24-hour high, hitting a record low before paring some of the losses.

articles.title: Webull expands crypto trading into Canada through Coinbase collaboration
articles.snippet: The brokerage is adding digital assets alongside stocks, ETFs and options as Canadian crypto ownership rises and regulators move toward clearer industry rules.
